rows: - All readings are compared with the design or permissible values
Maximum available turbine capacity as per ambient conditions
Maximum hot gas temperature at the turbine inlet
Maximum hot gas temperature at the turbine outlet
Temperature of the cooling medium for the turbine shaft
Pressure and temperature of the oil returning from the bearings
Results of fuel sample analysis "natural gas/special diesel"
Condition of the thermocouples and resistance thermometers and the tests and measurements carried out on:
Closed and open balancing reports for the turbine shaft after overhaul
Slow turning system for cooling the turbine shaft after the unit is taken out of service "Shaft Turning"
Unit start-up curves from standstill to Base Load "load, vibrations, temperatures, time" from the DCS
Unit load reduction and shutdown curves "load, vibrations, temperatures, time" from the DCS
Differential pressure across the air filters
Self-cleaning system for the air filters — Self cleanup
Dust collection and rejection system for the air entering the filters — Dust collector & rejection
Pressure and temperature at the compressor inlet and outlet
Temperature and pressure of the oil returning from the bearings
Moisture separation circuit for control circuit air "Air Dryer"
Inlet guide vane system at the compressor inlet and the date of the last maintenance — Inlet guide vanes
Partially compressed air cooling circuit, its efficiency and the maintenance carried out on it "Δt of the air entering and leaving the Intercooler"
Compressor stage blade washing system with the unit in service
Compressor stage blade washing system with the unit out of service
Maintenance reports for the control circuit air cooling system
Reports of water sample analysis from the combustion chamber injection cycle — Water Injection
Condition of flame monitoring cameras and viewers — Flame monitor/scanner
Calibration carried out on the fuel and water injection nozzles and valves at the last maintenance, and its date
Sound operation of the unit on the different fuel systems "natural gas / special diesel"
Fuel supply and return circuit from the fuel injection valves and nozzles in the chambers "diesel" and maintenance reports for it
Maintenance and inspection reports on the combustion chamber components
Maintenance and clearance and vibration measurements carried out on them
Hot gas outlet from the end of the turbine up to the stack
Maintenance carried out and crack detection tests
Results of hot gas sample analysis at the stack inlet and their conformity with the environmentally permissible values as per fuel type "natural gas/special diesel"
Colour of the exhaust leaving the stack as per fuel type "natural gas / special diesel"
Condition of the air inlet and outlet filters of the main oil tank
Separator and vapour extraction fan of the unit oil tank
Condition of the electric heaters of the oil tank
Rate of topping up the unit oil tank
Unit main fuel circuits "natural gas/special diesel"
Diesel circuit and the additives applied to it to avoid corrosion and improve combustion efficiency
Natural gas purging circuit to atmosphere when the unit is taken out of service "whether it operates automatically / manually" (its test reports)
Unit hall ventilation fans and openings, tight closing of its doors, ease of opening them from inside and opening them from outside through the lock
Main and daily fuel tanks "special diesel"
Cathodic protection of the fuel network
Maintenance programmes as per MPIS documents carried out on the unit: periodic, preventive, predictive, major overhauls, replacement and renewal
Clearance measurements for the fixed and moving blades of the turbine stages after overhaul
Required measurements for coupling joints and the straightness and centrality of the shafts at them after overhaul
Turbine maintenance workshop and special tools
- Record of rehabilitation of damaged parts replaced with new ones
